about.tagline: I'm a Systems Design Engineering student at the University of Waterloo aiming to make a positive impact on people's lives through technology.
description: I envision and create solutions using my building blocks of design and development to make the world a better place.
To me, solving problems are challenges I love tackling, and will embrace whenever I can because learning is a lifelong journey and it never stops.
When I'm not collaborating with others on fun projects, you can find me drawing, reading, watching the latest Star Wars show or playing Pokémon. Learn more about what I'm up to.

education.description: Systems Design Engineering is an interdisciplinary engineering that touches upon the software, business, and user design aspects of the engineering process with an emphasis on big picture thinking. I learn to connect the dots between traditional engineering disciplines and solve complex problems through code, modelling, design, and analytical thinking.
